whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm setup.cfg no longer carries an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk.
